answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 units for an exclusive operational slot, acting like a jade gate that guards registry access. Any evidence of fraud triggers a 180-day lock on all collateral, ensuring strict accountability for every autonomous agent.
